note: Young wizard, three-quarter view, long blue robe, a wooden staff held in the left (image-left) fist. Head is the blue pointed hat with its wide brim, the hair, ear and goatee, bottom y~462 at the chin; the blue robe, belt, the white lining at the left hem and the sleeve-like drape hanging at the right (x646-766, y716-802) are torso. Left arm: a wide bell sleeve hangs down the left body edge: upper part to y~568 is the upper arm (elbow guessed where the hand level starts), the lower sleeve (x360-426, y568-656) is the forearm pointing left, and the bare fist round the staff comes out of its opening (x276-364, y560-646). The staff is equipment: the carved knob (x210-338, y330-512), the shaft above the fist (y500-566) and the shaft below it (y646-843), kept off the fist. Right arm: bell sleeve upper arm from the shoulder to y~568 (halfway), the lower sleeve is the forearm to the wrist y~666, bare hand y664-742. Long robe: hip is the hem y~848 and covered thighs get no label; boots are lower leg from the hem to the ankles (left y~882, right y~898), boot toes are feet.
